other_conditions: The applicant must be registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB)
The parent must be actively engaged in building or construction work under HPBOCWWB
At least 90 days of building/construction work must have been completed in the last 12 months
The parent’s membership with the board must be active at the time of application
After three years, the worker must renew the registration and provide proof of 90 days of work each year
benefits_summary: Provides ₹15,000–₹20,000 annually for hostel stay, boarding, and food for the child of a registered construction worker.
documents_required: Wage slip or appointment letter verifying 90 days of work (or certificate from a local authority if unavailable)
